newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 28.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
BILLION STG BILL TO DIAL 020 FOR LONDON

A reorganisation of the telephone network planned for the year 2000, will include the introduction of an 020 code for London to replace the prefix numbers 0171 and 0181. Businesses may be given an 05 code, allowing them to keep their numbers if they move around the country.
CASPIAN PUSHES FOR EARLY PAY-TV SOCCER

The head of Caspian Group, Chris Akers, whose company owns Leeds United football club, is to lobby other Premiership club chairmen to put pressure on the league for an early introduction of pay-per-view football on television. The Premiership has recently denied that any talks have taken place with British Sky Broadcasting for a pay-per-view deal.
As talks with striking French lorry drivers broke down, speculation increased that a devaluation of the French franc was on the cards, possibly early next year.

Wall Street share prices are experiencing a 1987-style high, Kohlberg Kravis is rumoured set to make a huge leveraged buyout and fraud is rife in the States. Carl Icahn is engaged in his second proxy battle this year against managers at RJR Nabisco, threatening to replace its directors unless they carry out the "restructuring' he wants to take place.
